text: ghostty --class=NAME sets the Wayland app id, but GTK accepts only a valid application id: reverse-DNS with dots, every element starting with a letter. A bare word like 'extra' is rejected and the app id falls back to com.mitchellh.ghostty. decade places terminals by app id, using decade.w<id>.<pane> and decade.w<id>.<pane>.t<n> for pane tabs (Children::ghostty in src/children.rs, called by spawn_terminal and spawn_pane_tab in src/compositor.rs). Seen on 2026-11-06.
